culprit_citations.quoted_text: Consolidated Machine & Tool Holdings, LLC | ... | Amortized Cost (8) $ 6,041,963 | Fair Value (9) $ 5,503,482

findings.detail: Fair value currency is stored as XBRL unit code U002 even though the source SOI fair value column and schedule total are dollar-denominated.

rationale: FX02 flags fair_value_currency=U002 for this BDC quarter. The raw SOI schedule labels the fair value column with dollar signs, and the total investments row shows fair value as $325,772,154. The extracted unit code U002 therefore reflects an unmapped or mis-normalized currency unit rather than the source currency, so the flag is a real data error.
